{{Field procedure|summary=Prospect ordinary asteroids, cut free fragments with mining lasers, collect them, and refine them into cargo.}}

{{Callout|type=tip|label=Quick answer|1=For laser mining, bring mining lasers, a refinery, cargo space, limpets, a prospector controller, and collector controllers. Prospect each asteroid, mine only useful compositions, keep the cargo hatch clear of the rock, and launch collectors without targeting a fragment so they remain in area-collection mode.<ref name="miner">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Miner Miner], Elite Dangerous Wiki.</ref>}}

Use this procedure for '''laser mining''': cutting fragments from an asteroid's ordinary mineral composition with a [[Mining Laser]]. Surface deposits, sub-surface deposits, and asteroid cores require different tools and have their own procedures.<ref name="laser">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Mining_Laser Mining Laser], Elite Dangerous Wiki.</ref>

== Before departure ==

=== Required equipment ===

* One or more [[Mining Laser|mining lasers]].
* A [[Refinery]] with enough bins for the commodities being collected.
* One or more cargo racks for limpets and refined cargo.
* Limpets for prospecting and collection.

=== Recommended equipment ===

* An A-rated [[Prospector Limpet Controller]]. A prospector identifies an asteroid's composition, highlights deposits, reports remaining resources, and increases the number of fragments that can be extracted. A-rated controllers provide the highest fragment-yield multiplier.<ref name="prospector">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Prospector_Limpet_Controller Prospector Limpet Controller], Elite Dangerous Wiki.</ref>
* One or more [[Collector Limpet Controller|collector limpet controllers]]. Active collectors allow mining, collection, and refining to continue together.
* A [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] when using a [[Mining Hotspot|mining hotspot]].
* Shields, especially while learning close positioning around rotating asteroids.

Assign the mining lasers, prospector controller, and collector controllers to convenient fire groups. Make sure the power distributor can sustain the intended number of lasers; adding lasers shortens extraction time only when the distributor can supply them.<ref name="laser" />

== Choose the target ==

Select a commodity before leaving and check its article in [[Mining Commodities]]. The ring type must support that commodity through laser mining. A hotspot can improve the search for a named mineral, but its label does not override the ring's commodity distribution.

Use [[How to Scan Planetary Rings for Mining Hotspots]] when the ring has not been mapped. Prefer current route information over old overlap recommendations, and confirm the system reserve level when comparing laser-mining locations.

== Procedure ==

{{Procedure steps|
# Enter the selected ring or hotspot and reduce speed before approaching the asteroid field.
# Choose an asteroid with enough clear space around it for the ship and collector limpets.
# Launch a prospector limpet and target it after attachment.
# Read the composition. If the wanted commodity is absent or below the threshold set for the run, move to another asteroid.
# Approach within the mining laser's effective range. Face a slow-moving area near the asteroid's rotation axis where possible, and keep the cargo hatch and collector route clear of the surface.<ref name="edmining-laser">[https://edmining.com/laser-mining/ Elite Dangerous: Laser Mining], ED Mining.</ref>
# Put enough power into WEP to sustain the lasers without repeatedly draining the distributor or overheating the ship.
# Launch collector limpets while no fragment or cargo canister is targeted. This places them in autonomous area-collection mode rather than one-use collection mode.<ref name="miner" />
# Fire the mining lasers. Hold position while fragments break free and collectors carry them to the cargo hatch.
# Monitor the prospector's remaining-resource display, collector traffic, refinery bins, cargo capacity, heat, and distributor charge.
# When the asteroid is depleted or no longer useful, stop firing, allow nearby collectors to finish, and move to the next prospected asteroid.
# Continue until the planned cargo is refined, limpets are running low, the refinery or hold is blocked, or conditions make the run unsafe.
}}

== Refining and cargo management ==

Collected fragments pass into refinery bins. A bin transfers one unit of finished commodity to the cargo hold when it reaches 100 percent.<ref name="miner" /> If all suitable bins are occupied, unwanted minerals can block processing. Use the contacts ignore list to prevent collectors from gathering unwanted fragments, or vent an unwanted refinery bin when necessary; venting destroys its contents.

Leave cargo capacity for the refined commodities. Limpets occupy cargo space when the run begins, so consumed limpets normally create room as mining continues.

== Completion check ==

The procedure is complete when:

* the wanted cargo has been refined into the hold;
* no desired material remains stalled in the refinery hopper;
* active collectors have recovered the remaining useful fragments; and
* the ship can leave the ring safely and reach the intended buyer or delivery point.

Check live demand and market-report age before selling. A high advertised price with insufficient demand may not produce the expected return.

== Troubleshooting ==

* '''Collectors expire after one item:''' clear the fragment or canister target before launching the next limpet.
* '''Collectors repeatedly hit the asteroid:''' move so the cargo hatch and fragments have a clearer line of sight, preferably away from the asteroid's fast-moving edge.
* '''Fragments remain untouched:''' check active collector count, limpet stock, the contacts ignore list, cargo capacity, refinery bins, and whether the cargo hatch is obstructed.
* '''The refinery is blocked:''' allocate a bin to the wanted mineral, vent unwanted partial bins, or add unwanted fragments to the ignore list.
* '''Lasers stop firing:''' increase WEP allocation, reduce the number of simultaneous lasers, or allow the distributor to recharge.
* '''The ship overheats:''' stop firing, increase distance if the ship is scraping the asteroid, and resume with a shorter firing cycle.
* '''The target mineral is rare:''' confirm the ring type, hotspot selection, system reserve level, and commodity's supported laser-mining environment before changing the fit.
